sloka: न चान्यदपि वक्तव्यमतो वीर न शासनम् ।विलोक्यमानमिच्छामि मद्विधेन विशेषतः ।। ७.१०८.१५ ॥
transliteration: na cānyadapi vaktavyamato vīra na śāsanam ।vilokyamānamicchāmi madvidhena viśeṣataḥ ।। 7.108.15 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O hero, nothing else is to be said, and I do not wish this to be regarded as a command, especially by one like me.
